title: DeepLesion: automated mining of large-scale lesion annotations and universal lesion detection with deep learning

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《DeepLesion: automated mining of large-scale lesion annotations and universal lesion detection with deep learning》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Extracting, harvesting, and building large-scale annotated radiological image datasets is a greatly important yet challenging problem.

evidence.text: Extracting, harvesting, and building large-scale annotated radiological image datasets is a greatly important yet challenging problem.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《DeepLesion: automated mining of large-scale lesion annotations and universal lesion detection with deep learning》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We propose to mine and harvest these abundant retrospective medical data to build a large-scale lesion image dataset.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We mine bookmarks in our institute to develop DeepLesion, a dataset with 32,735 lesions in 32,120 CT slices from 10,594 studies of 4,427 unique patients.

evidence.text: We propose to mine and harvest these abundant retrospective medical data to build a large-scale lesion image dataset.
We mine bookmarks in our institute to develop DeepLesion, a dataset with 32,735 lesions in 32,120 CT slices from 10,594 studies of 4,427 unique patients.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《DeepLesion: automated mining of large-scale lesion annotations and universal lesion detection with deep learning》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Using DeepLesion, we train a universal lesion detector that can find all types of lesions with one unified framework.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】In this challenging task, the proposed lesion detector achieves a sensitivity of 81.1% with five false positives per image.

evidence.text: Using DeepLesion, we train a universal lesion detector that can find all types of lesions with one unified framework.
In this challenging task, the proposed lesion detector achieves a sensitivity of 81.1% with five false positives per image.
